purpose: Freeze the successful pilot_9_v6 CrisisCommunicationHub complex run, deterministic interaction re-evaluation, effective code, tests, inputs, and reports before proceeding to the next complex sample.
experimental_changes: The standalone interaction evaluator now injects an explicit deterministic Date implementation so Date.now-based identifiers are reproducible.
CrisisCommunicationHub interaction scenarios compare Vue and San state, computed values, and emitted events without another model call.
Object keys are canonicalized for equality while array order remains significant.
known_limitations: The interaction evaluator is a lightweight in-memory execution layer, not real-browser automation or screenshot comparison.
The remaining migration_hints_not_landed warning is a validator false positive because setValue delegates writes to this.data.set.
The model run did not use a recorded random seed, so this single complex result is case evidence rather than a statistical success-rate estimate.
